text: ねえ　この　みせの　うれすじは　どくけし　なんだって！

structure.jp: この　みせの　うれすじは
どくけし　なんだって！

patterns.name: 〜って (hearsay)
patterns.span: どくけし　なんだって
patterns.explanation: って at the end shows the speaker is passing on something they heard. どくけし　なんだって = 'I hear it's Antidote'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: なんだ is the short spoken form of なのだ, which presents a fact as an explanation or a piece of news. どくけし　なんだ = 'it's Antidote, you see'.
